title: Apply to transfer a liquor licence (with previous licensee's consent)
summary: You can apply to transfer a liquor licence online if you have the consent of the previous licensee.
intro:
You can transfer a liquor licence when you buy or sell a business or when you want to change the licensee. Usually Liquor & Gaming NSW will give you provisional approval, so the business can continue operating. Confirmation of the transfer will take about 60 days if all relevant training has been completed.

If you have the necessary authorisation, you can transfer online.

For up-to-date liquor licence guidelines, resources and tools visit Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing.

If you have questions or feedback about liquor licensing contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.
who_can_apply: Secretary or other office-bearer (for a limited liquor licence held by a non-proprietary association)
General manager of a council (for a limited liquor licence held by a non-proprietary association that is a public authority or community association)
Applicants must be 18 years or older
what_you_need: Name and contact details of the person lodging the form
The intended transfer date (must be at least 10 business days after application)
Representative's name and contact details (if applicable)
Proof of ownership (if you are the premises owner)
Details of the proposed licensee's industry experience and profile
Completed direct debit request form – PDF (if operating gaming machines)
Declaration by proposed licensee (if the applicant is not the proposed licensee)
Copy of your NSW National Police Check certificate (must be less than 3 months old)
Evidence of Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) qualification
Evidence of Responsible Conduct of Gambling (RCG) qualification (if operating gaming machines)
Personal details and evidence of an appointed liquor approved manager
Transferee's current Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) company information report showing directors and shareholders

how_to_steps.text: Enter your name and licence details.
Log in with your MyServiceNSW Account or create an account.
Follow the prompts to transfer a liquor licence (with previous licensee's consent).

faqs.q: How long does the transfer confirmation take?
faqs.a: Confirmation of the transfer will take about 60 days if all relevant training has been completed.

faqs.q: Who can apply to transfer a liquor licence?
faqs.a: Applicants can be the existing licensee, proposed licensee, premises owner, business owner, or other specific roles depending on the type of licence.

faqs.q: What is required to apply for a liquor licence transfer?
faqs.a: You will need a MyServiceNSW Account, the licence details, and various supporting documents such as police checks and qualifications.
